# Files that may be added to a pull request even though they are binary.
# Used by scripts/check_binary_artifacts.py (workflow: binary-artifacts-check).
#
# One pattern per line, matched against the path relative to the repository
# root with fnmatch rules: "*" matches any characters, including "/".
# Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored.
#
# Keep entries as narrow as possible and add a comment saying why the file has
# to be committed in binary form. Files that are already binary are never
# reported when they are only modified or renamed.

# Broadcom LED processor microcode, shipped per device
device/*/custom_led.bin
device/*/custom_led_*.bin
device/*/cmicx_customer_led.bin
device/*/led.bin
device/*/linkscan_fw.bin
device/*/linkscan_led.bin
device/*/linkscan_led_fw.bin

# Broadcom Cancun firmware packages
device/*/cancun/*.pkg
dockers/docker-pde/cancun_files/*.pkg

# Dell port locator microcode
device/dell/*/port-locator.bin

# Ragile firmware upgrade headers
device/ragile/*/latest_firmware/*.bin
